Arathi Heritage.name: Arathi Heritage
Arathi Heritage.description:
Origin Feat (Prerequisite: World of Warcraft Campaign, Human Species)

As a descendant of humans from Arathor and high elves from Quel’Thalas, you gain the following benefits.

Fey Ancestry. You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] condition.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.feats.Item.wowftArathiHerit.Activity.srQ53JHkaQvQngJG caption=false cite=false nameStyle=inline]

Lethargy Resilience.name: Lethargy Resilience
Lethargy Resilience.condition: When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the Unconcious condition
Lethargy Resilience.description: When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition, you can succeed instead. Once you use this trait, you can’t do so again until you finish 1d4 Long Rests.

Child of the Sea.name: Child of the Sea
Child of the Sea.description:
Origin Feat (Prerequisite: World of Warcraft Campaign, Human Species)

As a Kul Tiran, you gain the following benefits.

Lasting Breath. You can hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to 2 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 minute).

Ocean Born. You have a Swim Speed equal to your &Reference[Speed].

Ocean Born.name: Ocean Born
Ocean Born.description: You have a Swim Speed equal to your &Reference[Speed].

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-world-warcraft.feats.Item.wowftClearcastin.Activity.en1s4ztXM8zViORp caption=false cite=false nameStyle=inline]

Force Adept. When you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals Force damage, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

Clearcasting.name: Clearcasting
Clearcasting.condition: When you score a Critical Hit with a spell's attack roll
Clearcasting.description: When you score a Critical Hit with a spell’s attack roll, you can take a Reaction to cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action.

Enveloping Mist.name: Enveloping Mist
Enveloping Mist.condition: When you cast a spell or use a feature to restore Hit Points to a creature
Enveloping Mist.description:
When you cast a spell or use a feature to restore Hit Points to a creature, the creature is wrapped in a healing mist. Roll one of the dice from the feature that healed it, and note that number as the creature’s Life Cocoon value.

If the creature is hit by an attack roll before the start of its next turn, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage it takes from that attack by its Life Cocoon value. The mist then disappears.

At the start of the creature’s next turn, if the mist persists, the creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to its Life Cocoon value.

Enveloping Mist: Heal.name: Enveloping Mist: Heal
Enveloping Mist: Heal.condition: At the start of the creature's next turn
Enveloping Mist: Heal.description: At the start of the creature’s next turn, if the mist persists, the creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to its Life Cocoon value.

Enveloping Mist: Reduce Damage.name: Enveloping Mist: Reduce Damage
Enveloping Mist: Reduce Damage.condition: When the creature is hit by an attack roll before the start of its next turn

Frostbite.name: Frostbite
Frostbite.condition: When you deal Cold Damage to a creature that has the Restrained condition
Frostbite.description: When you deal Cold damage to a creature that has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition, the creature takes extra Cold damage. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus and add them together.

Cold Mastery.name: Cold Mastery
Cold Mastery.description: Spells you cast ignore &Reference[Resistance] to Cold damage.

Fists of Fury.name: Fists of Fury
Fists of Fury.description:
General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity and Wisdom 13+)

You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Clean Hits. When you roll damage for an attack you make with an Unarmed Strike or a weapon that has the Light property, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

Combo Strikes. When you deal damage to a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll for each time you previously hit that creature with a melee attack roll in the same turn.

Ignite.name: Ignite
Ignite.condition: When a spell you cast deals Fire damage to a creature
Ignite.description: When a spell you cast deals Fire damage to a creature, the target starts burning. When you deal Fire damage to a creature that is already burning, the flames become more severe, increasing the burning damage by 1d4.

Fire Mastery.name: Fire Mastery
Fire Mastery.description: Spells you cast ignore &Reference[Resistance] to Fire damage.

Inscription Adept.name: Inscription Adept
Inscription Adept.description:
General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Proficiency with Calligrapher’s Supplies, Cartographer’s Tools, or Painter’s Supplies)

Your mastery of inscription allows you to duplicate the effects of certain spells with your written magic. You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Inscription Magic. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplIllusorySc]{Illusory Script} spell and always have it prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. You can use herbalism resources of the appropriate value in place of the Material component specified for that spell. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

When you reach higher levels of proficiency in inscription, you learn higher-level spells and can cast them in the same way, as shown on the table.

Proficiency

Spell

Journeyman (+3)

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGlyphofWar]{Glyph of Warding}

Artisan (+5)

Defer Damage.name: Defer Damage
Defer Damage.description: When you take damage, reduce the damage you take by your Dexterity modifier (minimum of 1). Then add a d6 to your Delayed Reaction pool. At the end of your turn, remove all the dice from your Delayed Reaction pool and roll them. You take Force damage equal to the total rolled.

Purify.name: Purify
Purify.description: As a Bonus Action, you can remove a number of dice equal to your Wisdom modifier from your Delayed Reaction pool.

Deferred Damage.name: Deferred Damage
Deferred Damage.condition: At the end of your turn
Deferred Damage.description: At the end of your turn, remove all the dice from your Delayed Reaction pool and roll them. You take Force damage equal to the total rolled.

Will to Survive.name: Will to Survive
Will to Survive.description:
Origin Feat (Prerequisite: World of Warcraft Campaign, Human Species)

When you have the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition but not the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition, you can draw on the proud heritage of Stormwind or Stromgarde to ignore the Incapacitated condition on your turn. If you do, you gain 1 Exhaustion level.
